name: peri-rms-embedding-lr2
single_change: Add parameter-free RMS immediately after the shared token embedding, retaining the already tested Peri-RMS branch norms and all optimizer settings.
motivation: The branch-only Peri-RMS candidate exhausted the recall budget in all three short-screen seeds. An initialization-only training-input probe measured a first-attention-branch/residual RMS ratio of 48.26 on recall, versus 0.578 for the baseline; embedding RMS makes it 0.957. This scale imbalance is a proposed mechanism, not a demonstrated cause of the misses.
adaptation: Use the existing RMSNormEmbedding wrapper with the repaired RMS backward and native dtype epsilon. Preserve the exact embedding weight object shared with the readout, all random draws, unit residual coefficients, Q/K RMS, XSA, RoPE and prefix guard. No learned normalization gains, new trainable parameters, depth scaling, learning-rate or schedule changes.
screen_policy: Keep original budgets. Require 18/18 passes and improvement in at least three of the six per-task median paired epoch ratios versus LR x2 to advance. Preserve every screen row. No screen-only aggregate geometric mean is reported.
parent_comparison: Preserve all 18 paired screen rows against branch-only Peri-RMS as well, including its censored recall/square-sum cells. No paired geometric mean with censoring.
full_suite_policy: Evaluate all 75 paired short cells for every candidate that advances. Prefer complete coverage, then lower full-suite geometric-mean epochs. Compare against both original baseline and LR x2; include all per-task medians/worst cases, slower seeds and censoring. If no candidate improves on LR x2, retain the incumbent and report the negative results.
long_policy: Resolve both the cosine schedule and Peri-RMS short experiments before final selection. Run a new short winner on the already observed long regression suite once; never tune or reselect from long.
implementation_policy: Finish and archive the branch-only Peri-RMS screen before changing the candidate factory. Freeze new source/configuration and pass native-eager/capture and tied-embedding tests before starting the follow-up.
